scope: Sampled visual review, not frame-by-frame video viewing
method: Full-resolution retained interaction screenshots plus twelve sampled recording frames aligned approximately to screenshot write times
observations: Command rows wrap and remain inside the real work-item clipping area.
Mobile controls follow the toolbar and expose keyboard focus.
Unavailable-command text and retry action remain fully visible in a short host.
Shared media properties keep previews and fields usable at 1280px and 360px.
Source view retains command arguments and escaped close text; the saved label is visible after restart.
